measurement_scope.other_conditions: H2 atmosphere at 900 °C; CO2 and CH4 mixture at 750 °C

mechanism_relevant_findings: The relaxation study showed that the hydration process was faster for the La 6 W 2 O 15 compared to the LWO phase.
limitations: Conductivity of La 6 W 2 O 15 was one to two orders of magnitude lower compared to the phase pure La 6-x WO 12-δ.

relevance_judgement.reason: The study presents significant findings on proton conductivity mechanisms in mixed conductors.
